versions.changelog: 重写导航文档：新增快速路由表+13技能四段式边界说明(适用边界/能做什么/不能做什么/该装不装)，keji自身置顶为总入口

- Clarified pricing and quota-sharing for literature search-related skills.
- Enhanced the description, trigger words, and cross-linking to provide a broader entry point for all major research scenarios.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
